title: VLAN Tagging & Trunk Port Misconfiguration on Edge Switches
description: Intermediate IT infrastructure and operations module analyzing vlan tagging & trunk port misconfiguration on edge switches.
learning_objectives: Master professional Conditionals in Network Diagnostics in enterprise IT infrastructure and cloud operations
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in vlan tagging & trunk port misconfiguration on edge switches
Demonstrate precision in Zero Trust architecture, ITIL incident management, and cyber governance

questions.prompt: If the secondary fiber link _____ during high traffic load, the BGP router will reroute packets automatically.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('fails') for automated network routing rules.
explanations.wrong_C: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'failed' creates an unreal condition, mismatched with 'will reroute'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Never use 'will' in network troubleshooting if-clauses (*If the link will fail*). Use Present Simple: 'If the link fails'.
